blurb: Guests can play golf with various green fee rates depending on time and day. The course offers junior golf leagues, camps, and adult lessons including a novice clinic and Operation 36 Golf Academy. Tee times can be reserved online or via a mobile app with a credit card hold required.
extraNote: Tee times require credit card to hold but are charged on day of play · Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours before tee time to avoid full charge · No-shows or late cancellations may be charged minimum $25 up to full green fee · Golf carts not guaranteed due to demand · No refunds for Novice Learning Clinic once program begins · Golf Shop at Coal Creek Golf Course, 585 W Dillon Rd., Louisville, CO
